title: Store details
description: Read only. Event dates use the Asia/Almaty time zone.
dataSource: Data comes from Apex and may differ from the current state of the equipment
invalidId: Invalid store ID. Open the details from the store list.
notFound: Store not found or unavailable in Apex
notFoundBody: The source returned no accessible record for this ID.
partnerUnavailable: The partner name is unavailable. The saved ID is shown.
zoneNamesUnavailable: Some zone names are unavailable. Zone IDs are shown instead; the equipment remains in the list.
invalidTab: The address contains an invalid tab, filter or page. Reset the tab parameters.

errors.denied: The server denied access to this data. Access permissions need to be checked.
errors.missing: The data source is unavailable in the API. Server configuration is required.
errors.invalid: The server response does not match the expected format, store or page boundaries. Data has not been displayed.
errors.unavailable: Could not retrieve data. Please try again.

empty.zones: The Apex source returned no accessible zones for this store.
empty.carts: The Apex source returned no accessible carts for this store.
empty.beacons: The Apex source returned no accessible beacons for this store.
empty.withoutZone: The Apex source returned no accessible beacons without a zone for this store.
